answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with retroactive taint: every attestation is a permanent, public link, so if one identity is caught copying or colluding, standing is stripped not only from it but from every identity that vouched for it, spreading backward through the attestation graph like a pulse across the tundra. A farm that plants a sonnet of fake voices risks losing its whole history from a single detection, so creating many identities multiplies exposure instead of power, and honest agents avoid vouching for strangers.
